settings.heading: Jewellery Care
settings.subheading: A little extra care will keep your BLÓMINOR jewellery beautiful for longer.

settings.text: Put jewellery on after perfume, creams, makeup and hairspray
Keep jewellery away from chemicals, hand sanitiser and cleaning products
Remove jewellery before showering, swimming, exercising, sleeping or doing household work
After wearing, gently wipe with a soft, dry and lint-free cloth
Do not use silver dip, strong jewellery cleaners, polishing paste or rough cloths
Do not use an ultrasonic or steam cleaner
Store each piece separately in its original BLÓMINOR box or pouch, in a cool and dry place away from sunlight and humidity

settings.title: Opening & Closing
settings.content: Do not push or slide the bracelet over the hand. Always open the clasp before placing it around the wrist. Close the clasp gently and make sure it is secure. If the bracelet has an additional safety lock, fasten this as well.

settings.title: Handle with Care
settings.content: Do not pull, bend or force the bracelet open — this may change its shape and damage the clasp or locking mechanism. Handle enamel flowers, pearls, stones and raised details with care.
